items.sentence: Today, the camera will record the bird building its nest.
Families settle near the river and build farms on flat land.
Today, baking bread is the occupation of the cheerful villager.
A dark mass of clouds gathers above the quiet town.
Today, the woodpecker will tap gently on the old tree trunk.
Today, the baby monkey will grasp its mother's soft warm fur.
Today, the dancing bear enjoyed fame across the whole forest.
Thick wool blankets offered comfort during the cold snowy night.
One small hole in the fence let the rabbits through.
Today, the young climbers finally succeed at reaching the tall rock.
